entry_definition: original T0 executable entry: OPEN of the first 1s bar with ts_init > T0 observation; entry instant = that bar's ts_event; unchanged

event_semantics.before_terminal: touch time strictly before the terminal opposite 1m flip (atlas convention)
event_semantics.checkpoint_state: at c = T0 + e: bars with ts_init <= c, regimes with start <= c; e in [0, 30, 60, 120, 180, 285] s (canonical collector checkpoints k=0,2,4,8,12,19)
event_semantics.event_anchored_state: at a first-touch bar: bars through that bar (inclusive), regimes with start <= touch time
event_semantics.htf_transition: a regime's start_ns = its detection bar close; known at that instant; first transition = first regime starting strictly inside (T0 observation, terminal flip); INTO if its dir == trade dir
event_semantics.price_touch: first 1s bar (entry bar included) whose HIGH/LOW reaches entry +/- k*ATR (kernel arithmetic); time = that bar's close (ts_init); a >300 s bar gap before the touch censors
event_semantics.ties: a 5m/15m/1h detection close and a 1s touch bar close at the same second are 'at or before' each other; counted separately

missing_primitives: collector checkpoint rows are gappy (32% of trades miss some k); structural state after T0 is therefore not used -- path state is rebuilt from 1s bars, MTF state from exact regime chains
checkpoints stop at 285 s after T0 (collector max_age 300 s)
population: 2023 development sessions (first 80%, 205 sessions), audited Target-A-eligible T0 trades
